name: Aurora
description: Pinku uses oriental fantasy themes to create the legendary story of Tianyinxian: In the Nine Heavens Immortal World, Tianyin Xianzun, who is in charge of the thirty-six orchestras in the heaven, collects a Tianyin Stone that contains mysterious energy. Legend has it that touching the spirit stone can produce two completely different sounds of nature. The Tianyin Stone was lost in a battle between immortals and demons, during which it was struck by lightning. The other half of the stone fell to the mist-shrouded Qiyun Valley and transformed into the shape of a guzheng. The dreamlike Qiyun Valley is full of exotic flowers and plants all year round. Legend has it that every full moon, the strange flowers in the valley will transform into faint amethysts, reflecting the fluorescent light in the sky, and transforming into mysterious and romantic haze.
